evidence: app/src/env.ts:1-9 — defineEnvVars/$app/env, experimental as of Kit 2.62 (June 2026), standard since Kit 3.0 (2026-10-01), powers every API fetch
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45 — goto(..., { reset: false }), a one-month-old Kit 3 API
app/package.json:8-19 — SvelteKit 3.1 / Vite 8 / TS 6 toolchain, all stable less than 6 months
app/src/routes/+error.svelte:2 — page from $app/state, stable since Kit 2.12 (Feb 2025), not new
reach.rationale: Nothing currently experimental, but the app is built squarely on the one-month-old SvelteKit 3 major and leans on its recently-graduated env-var API in the central data-fetching path — squarely 'recently-stable APIs in central places'.

evidence: app/src/env.ts:1-9 — env var definition isolated in the single canonical src/env.ts module
app/src/lib/server/api.ts:2 — the only consumer of $app/env/private; swapping the API touches one line plus env.ts
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45 and app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:111 — reset: false confined to the two routes that need it
app/vite.config.ts:8-10 — runes option confined to the one config file
containment.rationale: Every new-ish API sits behind a single module, a single consumer, or a single route; if any of them changes, the blast radius is one or two files.

evidence: app/src/env.ts:4-7 — schema provides the spec-required default and strips trailing slashes; the deprecated $env/static/private could not validate or default
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45 — reset: false keeps focus/scroll on search/filter updates, which no stable alternative covers post-Kit-3
app/vite.config.ts:8-10 — per-file runes forcing is the documented sv CLI pattern, with a comment noting it can be dropped in Svelte 6
app/src/routes/+error.svelte:2 — $app/state is the current standard, not novelty
justification.rationale: Each recently-stable API buys something the stable alternative couldn't (validation, UX, compile-safety), and the one genuinely not-ready Kit 3 feature — remote functions — was sensibly avoided.

findings.issue: goto(..., { reset: false }) is stable but one month old, and upstream issue sveltejs/kit#16990 (open, 2026-09-01) shows its scroll/focus semantics may be revisited.
findings.suggestion: Fine to keep; centralize the two call sites' navigation option in a tiny helper if the option shape churns in a Kit 3.x patch.

findings.issue: The entire toolchain (SvelteKit 3, Vite 8 with Rolldown, TypeScript 6, adapter-node 6) reached stable on 2026-10-01, four weeks before today; ecosystem breakage risk is elevated for a codebase owned for years.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable since these are the current stable minimums; keep the caret ranges and watch Kit 3.x patch releases closely in the first quarter.

summary: The app is aggressively current but not reckless: it targets the SvelteKit 3 stable line and its recently-graduated env-var system, and touches nothing that is still experimental or preview. Every new-ish API is isolated in one module, one consumer, or one route and is justified by a real need. The only risk worth noting is the youth of the entire stack, not any experimental API.
